students.name: Muhamad Nabil Harith Bin Mohamad Azlan

quests.title: The Great Xiaolongbao Quest
quests.description: Taste authentic soup dumplings and order using Chinese phrases.
quests.task: Take a photo of steaming soup dumplings with black vinegar & ginger from a local shop near Jing’An.

quests.title: Maglev 300 km/h Speed Run (Optional Free-Time)
quests.description: Optional self-arranged exploration during personal free time: experience magnetic levitation at up to 300 km/h (not on official schedule).
quests.task: Snap a selfie next to the on-board speed display showing 300 km/h during self-arranged transit.

quests.title: Oriental Pearl & Huangpu Cruise Skyline
quests.description: Capture Shanghai’s blend of history and modernity from the Oriental Pearl TV Tower and Huangpu River cruise (Day 4 Cultural Visit).
quests.task: Photograph the illuminated skyline from the Oriental Pearl TV Tower observation deck or during the Huangpu River Cruise.

quests.title: Shanghainese Slang Street Test
quests.description: Learn and use authentic local expressions with local shopkeepers.
quests.task: Greet someone with "Nong Hao" (侬好) and say "Xie Xie Nong" (谢谢侬) when receiving change or goods.

quests.title: ebm-papst & SJTU Green Engineering Pioneer
quests.description: Engage with engineers on EC motor aerodynamics at ebm-papst and refrigeration research at SJTU.
quests.task: Take a photo or note key engineering takeaways during the ebm-papst factory or SJTU Building Environment Lab visits.

quests.title: Metro Navigation Pathfinder
quests.description: Navigate Shanghai’s public transit network using local metro QR or transportation cards.
quests.task: Take a picture of a Shanghai Metro station platform or transfer signage and keep a record of your transit card or Alipay transport QR.

quests.title: Cultural Workshop: Chinese Calligraphy
quests.description: Master Chinese calligraphy brushwork during the Day 4 Cultural Workshop at Shanghai University (The 2nd floor of CIE).
quests.task: Write a Chinese character (e.g. 龙, 德, 和) with traditional brush and ink during the Day 4 SHU Cultural Workshop (The 2nd floor of CIE).

quests.title: Cultural Workshop: Taiji Mind-Body Balance
quests.description: Learn fundamental Taiji breathing, internal martial arts stances, and physical coordination at SHU (Day 2: 14:30–16:00).
quests.task: Participate in Cultural Workshop 1 — Taiji on Day 2 afternoon (14:30–16:00) at Shanghai University.

quests.title: Shanghai University Youth Network
quests.description: Connect and build authentic cross-border friendships with local Shanghai University undergraduates.
quests.task: Exchange contacts (WeChat ID or social handle) with at least 5 Shanghai university students during campus exchanges.

quests.title: Closing Ceremony Spotlight Showcase
quests.description: Celebrate the journey in the Official Closing Ceremony (Day 6: 13:30–14:00 at The 3rd floor of CIE).
quests.task: Participate in a performance, reflection presentation, or ceremony speech during the Day 6 Closing Ceremony at CIE (3rd Floor).

quests.title: Shanghai Local Market Bargain Master
quests.description: Practice everyday conversational Mandarin at a local market or shop using polite bargaining etiquette.
quests.task: Successfully negotiate a souvenir discount using phrases like "多少钱" or "便宜一点" and show receipt/item photo.

quests.title: SJTU Dragon Pose Creative Snapshot
quests.description: Take an epic team commemorative picture with Shanghai engineering buddies.
quests.task: Strike a collaborative DE engineering dragon formation pose with local students in front of the iconic campus gate or engineering library.
